rows.grounds: bhauma = of Mars; varṇa = color; accusative object of samāruhya
sam-ā-ruh participle; governs the preceding color phrase
tri = three; sahasra = thousand; accusative count
manu = mantra; accusative object of japet

items.question: What mantra count follows ascending mars-color in this ritual prescription?
premises: The mantra is recited three thousand times.
The prescription uses an optative verb.
items.inference: After ascending the Mars-color, the practitioner should recite the mantra three thousand times.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of bhaumavarṇaṃ is not specified beyond Mars-color.
The precise mantra intended by manuṃ is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having ascended the Mars-color, one should recite the mantra three thousand times.
